def total(state) do

def by_category(state) do

def set_budget(state, category, amount) do
  budgets = Map.put(Map.get(state, "budgets", %{}), category, amount)
  {amount, Map.put(state, "budgets", budgets)}
end

def over_budget(state) do
  spent = by_category(state)

  state
  |> Map.get("budgets", %{})
  |> Enum.filter(fn {c, limit} -> Map.get(spent, c, 0) > limit end)
  |> Enum.map(fn {c, _} -> c end)
  |> Enum.sort()
end

def top_category(state) do
  spent = by_category(state)

  spent
  |> Map.keys()
  |> Enum.sort()
  |> Enum.reduce(nil, fn c, best -> if best == nil or spent[c] > spent[best], do: c, else: best end)
end
